title: P101_19Sep
extract_protocol_ch1: Live frozen PBMCs were thawed and washed twice with RPMI supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 20 µg/mL DNase I (Sigma-Aldrich), and resuspended in 1× PBS. Cells were washed with PBS and stained with Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Dye according to the manufacturer’s recommendations. Live cells were fluorescence-activated cell sorted (FACS) into PBS supplemented with 5% FBS. Sorted cells were stained with a cocktail of TotalSeq™-A oligonucleotide-conjugated antibodies (BioLegend) in PBS containing 5% FBS, 2 mM EDTA, and 5 mg/mL human IgG, following the manufacturer’s recommendations, to enable cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes by sequencing (CITE-seq). Cells were washed twice with PBS supplemented with 5% FBS and resuspended in PBS supplemented with 1% BSA (Miltenyi) and 0.5 U/µL RNase inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich). Approximately 9,000 cells were targeted for each experiment.

The PBMC suspension was used as input for automated microfluidic single-cell capture and barcoding using the 10x Genomics Chromium iX platform. Cells were mixed with the reverse transcription master mix and subjected to partitioning along with Chromium gel beads to generate single-cell gel beads in emulsion (GEMs) using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Gene Expression v3 chemistry (10x Genomics). Feature Barcoding technology (10x Genomics) was used for generation of antibody-derived tag (ADT) libraries from TotalSeq™-A antibodies, according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Individual cells were uniquely barcoded during GEM generation and reverse transcription. Following reverse transcription, cDNA was recovered and purified using Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Silane beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter). Gene expression and ADT libraries were constructed according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Constructed libraries underwent quality control assessment using a High Sensitivity D1000 DNA ScreenTape (Agilent) and were quantified using a Qubit Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a KAPA Library Quantification Kit (KAPA Biosystems) on the AriaMx instrument (Agilent).

title: P136_26Sep
extract_protocol_ch1: Live frozen PBMCs were thawed and washed twice with RPMI supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 20 µg/mL DNase I (Sigma-Aldrich), and resuspended in 1× PBS. Cells were washed with PBS and stained with Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Dye according to the manufacturer’s recommendations. Live cells were fluorescence-activated cell sorted (FACS) into PBS supplemented with 5% FBS. Sorted cells were stained with a cocktail of TotalSeq™-A oligonucleotide-conjugated antibodies (BioLegend) in PBS containing 5% FBS, 2 mM EDTA, and 5 mg/mL human IgG, following the manufacturer’s recommendations, to enable cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes by sequencing (CITE-seq). Cells were washed twice with PBS supplemented with 5% FBS and resuspended in PBS supplemented with 1% BSA (Miltenyi) and 0.5 U/µL RNase inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich). Approximately 9,000 cells were targeted for each experiment.

The PBMC suspension was used as input for automated microfluidic single-cell capture and barcoding using the 10x Genomics Chromium iX platform. Cells were mixed with the reverse transcription master mix and subjected to partitioning along with Chromium gel beads to generate single-cell gel beads in emulsion (GEMs) using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Gene Expression v3 chemistry (10x Genomics). Feature Barcoding technology (10x Genomics) was used for generation of antibody-derived tag (ADT) libraries from TotalSeq™-A antibodies, according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Individual cells were uniquely barcoded during GEM generation and reverse transcription. Following reverse transcription, cDNA was recovered and purified using Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Silane beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter). Gene expression and ADT libraries were constructed according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Constructed libraries underwent quality control assessment using a High Sensitivity D1000 DNA ScreenTape (Agilent) and were quantified using a Qubit Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a KAPA Library Quantification Kit (KAPA Biosystems) on the AriaMx instrument (Agilent).
